obligation: G127 -- the battery must REJECT a known-bad artifact
the_gap: G0 scores 0.98 on 58 scored items. BOTH known-bads score 0.00 with 60 of 60 truncated -- a total separation on every one of the ten categories. A battery that passes everything is a broken battery; this one rejects both.

the_deliberate_corruption.method: hardlinked every one of the 1,108 tensor files from uniform-q4-v1, then damaged ONE: 23,746 bytes XORed across the code region of layer 40's mlp.down_proj, 47,349,800 bytes. The header was left intact deliberately so the artifact LOADS and is then wrong -- a file that fails to parse tests the loader, not the battery.
the_deliberate_corruption.finding: 0.00017% of the artifact's bytes, in ONE tensor of 1,108, takes the model from 0.98 to 0.00. That is a fragility result as much as a control: there is no graceful degradation here.

BOTH_FAIL_THE_SAME_WAY_AND_IT_IS_NOT_BY_: Neither bad artifact gets items wrong. Both TRUNCATE on 60 of 60 -- they never close a think block. So the battery's discriminating signal is TERMINATION, not correctness, which is the same signature G076 found at 53 items and G076's known-bad showed at 100% truncation. A score-only battery would have reported '0.00 correct' and missed that the failure mode is non-termination.
consequence_for_G126s_ceiling: G126 recorded that G0 aces nine of ten categories and that widening item count did not widen resolution. These controls show the battery is not blind -- it separates a broken artifact totally. What it cannot do is rank two HEALTHY artifacts, and these two results bound the instrument from the other side: it is a rejection test, not a ranking test.
harness_limit_hit_on_the_way: the first corrupted run failed with 'GQA position 1024 exceeds max_seq_len 1024' on a long-context item -- a harness limit, not corruption, and the artifact had already loaded and generated. Re-run at 2048. Recorded because a failure that looks like the artifact but is the harness is exactly the confusion this campaign keeps finding.
